description: This file defines the GreaterBinary class, a component of the Twig templating engine that handles the 'greater than' binary operator in expression parsing.

classes.name: GreaterBinary
classes.description: A class representing the 'greater than' binary operation in Twig expressions, providing compilation logic for this operator.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the 'greater than' expression into PHP code, with special handling for PHP versions below 8.0 by using a comparison function.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw PHP operator for 'greater than' ('>').
